entries.name: WP2 plug-in foundations
entries.why: Measured growth of the start (plan allowance 1.0 KB): the emit sites in main.ts and hud-combat.ts, the sending end of the event bus, the features loader with its one retry, bossApproach, and addPhrases in i18n.ts. The bus, the services and every feature load after Start.

entries.name: WP10 hero gait blend
entries.why: Measured growth of the start (plan allowance 0.3 KB): hero-motion.ts, the blend between the idle and the walk pose that runs from the first frame, in place of the switch in world.ts animatePlayer. The lean-in, the settle, the fidgets, the sit and the clips load after Start (features/hero-idle.ts).

entries.name: WP24 fair rewards and true words
entries.why: The plan's allowance (0.1 KB). Measured growth of the start against staging 48da5cb: English +187 bytes, Vietnamese +275; the 85 and 173 bytes past the allowance come out of the room earlier packages left under the limit. In the start by nature: the bounty cap (progression.ts, with the zone table now beside the spawn tables in enemy-types.ts), the soothed rate in grantColossusReward (colossus-rewards.ts, shared with the server), the one-line well hook and the longer level-20 News sentence in main.ts, and '1 day in a row' with its Vietnamese. Loaded on demand, not in the start: the well's view (colossus-well-ui chunk, 1.5 KB gzip, fetched when the well opens; it imports no game module at run time, which would re-split the start chunks, +1.3 KB measured), its Vietnamese (features-vi, +0.9 KB of that chunk's 15 KB) and Automatic's pay rule (colossus.ts, the modes chunk). news.json is 20 bytes smaller.
